nuggets.title: New Catalog Images Missing from Visual Search for 12 Hours

scenario.symptoms: Merchants upload inventory photos but visual search returns no matches until next day. Marketing campaign underperforms because index embedding pipeline batches nightly.
scenario.interviewerSetup: Embedding workers run daily batch over object storage; no incremental index updates on upload webhook.

incident.headline: Batch-only indexing pipeline leaves new product images unsearchable for hours

agenda.goal: Near-real-time embedding and index upsert on catalog changes with SLA on freshness.
agenda.opener: Shoppers can't find products by photo until tomorrow. How fast do new images enter the visual index?

evidence.strong: Event-driven embed on upload, streaming upsert to vector DB, freshness SLA metrics, backfill plus incremental, dual write during model upgrades.

misconceptions.pattern: Full re-scan of bucket is enough for updates.
misconceptions.challenge: How long to re-embed 100M images nightly?

probes: How do you update index without full rebuild?
agenda.referenceFix: Streaming pipeline from upload to embed to vector upsert within minutes.

nuggets.title: Embedding Model Upgrade Requires Full Reindex

scenario.symptoms: Team ships v2 vision model with incompatible embedding space; mixed v1/v2 vectors in same index collapse search relevance until full 5-day reembed completes.
scenario.interviewerSetup: Single index accepts vectors from both models without version partition or query-time model tag.

incident.headline: Incompatible embedding models cohabiting one index destroy nearest-neighbor semantics

agenda.goal: Plan model upgrades with separate index versions, dual-write reembed, and cutover once coverage met.
agenda.opener: We upgraded the vision model and search quality collapsed mid-reindex. How do you roll out a new embedding model?

evidence.strong: Versioned indices, query uses matching model version, background reembed with progress, flip traffic at threshold, never mix spaces in one index.
evidence.adequate: Big bang offline reindex with downtime.
evidence.weak: In-place mix of old and new vectors.

misconceptions.pattern: Assumes L2 normalize makes different models compatible.
misconceptions.challenge: Are v1 and v2 vectors in the same semantic space?

probes: When do you cut query traffic to v2 index?
hints: Dual query during migration if needed.
agenda.referenceFix: Build v2 index in parallel, reembed all items, cutover query when complete.

nuggets.title: Deleted Products Still Appear in Visual Matches

scenario.symptoms: Users tap visually similar items and land on 404 product pages for delisted SKUs. Vector index retains embeddings after catalog tombstone without delete propagation.
scenario.interviewerSetup: Catalog service marks items deleted in SQL but vector DB upsert pipeline has no delete events.

incident.headline: Vector index lacks delete propagation for delisted catalog items

agenda.goal: Keep visual index consistent with catalog via CDC deletes and post-filter on live catalog.
agenda.opener: Visual search recommends products that no longer exist. How do removals flow to the index?

evidence.strong: CDC delete to vector DB, periodic consistency sweeps, filter NN results against catalog service, tombstone metadata in index.

misconceptions.pattern: Thinks index only needs inserts for new items.
misconceptions.challenge: What happens when SKU is delisted?

probes: Can you filter at query time?
agenda.referenceFix: Consume delete events for vector removal plus live catalog filter on results.

nuggets.title: Heavy Cross-Encoder Rerank Blows Mobile Latency SLO

scenario.symptoms: Mobile visual search p99 hits 2.8s after adding cross-encoder rerank on 200 ANN candidates sequentially on CPU.
scenario.interviewerSetup: Two-stage pipeline runs expensive reranker on full candidate list without top-k trim or GPU batching.

incident.headline: Unbounded reranking stage exceeds mobile latency budget after retrieval

agenda.goal: Rerank top-k with batched GPU inference and timeout fallback to ANN ordering.
agenda.opener: Adding reranking made visual search feel sluggish on phones. How many candidates do you rerank under 300ms?

evidence.strong: ANN top 50 then batched GPU rerank, cascade lightweight model first, strict stage timeouts, skip rerank on slow path.

misconceptions.pattern: Believes reranking all ANN hits always helps.
misconceptions.challenge: What is p99 if you score 200 pairs serially?

probes: What k is enough for quality?
agenda.referenceFix: Top-40 rerank batched on GPU with 150ms budget; degrade gracefully.

nuggets.title: Offline Metric Looks Great on Studio Photos Only

scenario.symptoms: Offline recall@10 improves 10% on benchmark but user-shot mirror selfies perform poorly in beta. Eval set lacks noisy real-world query images.
scenario.interviewerSetup: Evaluation uses curated studio packshots as queries instead of logged user camera uploads.

incident.headline: Offline evaluation on studio queries misrepresents real-world visual search quality

agenda.goal: Evaluate on logged user queries with human labels plus slice metrics for noise, lighting, and category.
agenda.opener: Benchmarks improved but beta users say results are wrong for phone photos. How do you evaluate visual search?

evidence.strong: Human-judged eval on sampled production queries, slice by capture conditions, A/B on click-through to product, hard negative mining from confusions.

misconceptions.pattern: Assumes catalog packshots represent user queries.
misconceptions.challenge: Do users photograph items in the same lighting as studio?

probes: Where do eval queries come from?
agenda.referenceFix: Production-sampled eval set with human relevance labels; gate releases on slice metrics.
